messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — we're about to start a staged toggle for `feature.routing-v2` at 16:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, 5m checks between steps. Goal is to validate latency tail and error-rate under mixed traffic. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-routing-v2

jason: ack. I'll watch token latency and the per-model QPS dashboards. If P95 jumps >50ms or errors +1% we pause.

amanda: deploy-bot will run the flag-change and pin on failures. Do not manually unpin unless we call it. Ops runbook: /playbooks/flag-pressure-valve.md

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled toggle `feature.routing-v2` -> 1% at 16:00 UTC. Canary window 5m. Command: `rbctl feature set routing-v2 --percent 1` and `rbctl rollout watch --flag routing-v2`.

maria: copying release note snippet to #release-notes. Are we including the quantization fallback in this rollout?

amanda: yes — fallback chain: routing-v2 -> routing-v1-quantized if latency > 300ms. That's part of the smart routing policy.

sre-oncall: I'll set an escalations page for 20m. If deploy-bot reports a fail, we'll fast-drain to 0% and pin to last-good sha.

kevin: small nit — prefer 3m checks on first two steps (1% and 5%) to catch noisy signals early. otherwise +1.
jason: +1 to kev. Amanda, can we shorten the first checks to 3m?
amanda: yes, updated plan: 1% (3m) -> 5% (3m) -> 25% (5m) -> 100% (5m).

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting step 1: `feature.routing-v2` -> 1% (3m). Watch ID: fb-20260321-01. Logs: https://deploylogs.internal/fb-20260321-01

amanda: monitoring: p50/p95/p99 + error-rate + model-fallbacks. If any step breaches thresholds, deploy-bot will auto-revert and pin: `rbctl feature set routing-v2 --percent 0 && rbctl feature pin routing-v2 --sha <last-good>`

sre-oncall: seeing an uptick in KV cache misses at 1% — not too big but noted. If it trends we'll pause before 5%.
jason: also seeing a spike in token-generation latency for a small subset (long-context). Keeping eyes on that cohort.

amanda: ok hold for 2m while we observe. If stable we continue, else we drain to 0%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Health check passed for step 1. Proceeding to step 2 -> 5% (3m). :rocket:

maria: thumbs up from docs — included a short rollback blurb in the release notes and list of impacted routes.

kevin: remind the oncall to check region eu-west separately — traffic mix differs.
sre-oncall: noted, I'll open a regional watch.

amanda: final: if we hit any of the following, we stop and rollback: token latency p95 +100ms, errors +1pp, fallback rate >2% sustained. Otherwise full ramp to 100% in the window.

jason: thanks. ping here if we need to cut to 0 quickly. :thumbsup:

amanda: thanks all — posting an abbreviated postmortem template in thread if anything goes wrong.
